import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

wt = Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/selfdev-20261007")
expected = "6e39cbcd7f1c3ca8f0ebfac6a2b9d6b2948a1b58"

def run(args, check=True, env=None):
    return subprocess.run(args, cwd=wt, text=True, capture_output=True, check=check, env=env)

head = run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip()
branch = run(["git","branch","--show-current"]).stdout.strip()
if head != expected or branch != "feat/self-dogfood-20261007":
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected isolated state head={head} branch={branch}")

test = wt/"tests/test_cli.py"
text = test.read_text()

if "import json\n" not in text:
    text = text.replace("import io\n", "import io\nimport json\n", 1)

old = "from do_again.cli import list_projects, main, setup_project, verify_project\n"
new = """from do_again.cli import (
    list_projects,
    main,
    request_history,
    setup_project,
    show_logs,
    trace_request,
    verify_project,
)
from do_again.service.runtime import runtime_layout
"""
if old not in text:
    raise SystemExit("CLI test import anchor missing")
text = text.replace(old, new, 1)
test.write_text(text)

env = os.environ.copy()
env["PYTHONPATH"] = str(wt/"src")

run(["python3","-m","py_compile","src/do_again/cli.py","tests/test_cli.py"], env=env)
print("py_compile=ok")

focused = run(
    ["python3","-m","unittest",
     "tests.test_cli",
     "tests.test_request_fingerprints",
     "tests.test_agent_claims"],
    check=False,
    env=env,
)
print("=== focused stdout ===")
print(focused.stdout)
print("=== focused stderr ===")
print(focused.stderr)
print("focused_rc=" + str(focused.returncode))
if focused.returncode != 0:
    raise SystemExit(focused.returncode)

run(["git","add","src/do_again/cli.py","tests/test_cli.py"])
commit = run(["git","commit","-m","Add durable request diagnostics"], check=False)
print("=== commit stdout ===")
print(commit.stdout)
print("=== commit stderr ===")
print(commit.stderr)
if commit.returncode != 0:
    raise SystemExit(commit.returncode)

print("new_head=" + run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip())
print("status_after=" + repr(run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout))
